description: M62's sqrt(N) acceptance battery, in data. Nothing here names a binary, a gate or a subcommand -- those live in `argv`, so a different merge is tested by editing this file or passing --spec, never by editing code.

roles.instrument: binary-independent arithmetic. If one of these fails the HARNESS changed, and no verdict about any merge can be issued.
roles.decision: the claim under test. Must PASS for CERTIFY.
roles.power: an invocation that is supposed to score at or below `selector_ceiling`. Discipline 419: a battery whose failing arms have all vanished certifies nothing. At least ONE power arm must run and score low, or the verdict is CANNOT-CERTIFY. A power arm that scores HIGH is not a failure of the merge -- it may mean that entry point was deliberately converted to an estimator -- it is a loss of the control, and is reported as NO-POWER.

arms.name: A0-ladder
arms.note: arithmetic. Calibrates the instrument across the range; independent of any binary.

arms.name: B1a-const-selector
arms.note: copy frame 0 everywhere. The zero point.

arms.name: B1b-random-selector
arms.note: full winner histogram, no noise coupling (rule 11's placebo).

arms.name: DEFAULT
arms.note: NO tuning flags. This is the arm that decides whether the estimating merge is the DEFAULT path. If the binary refuses this invocation the arm is UNSUPPORTED, which is itself a result.

arms.name: SELECTOR-shipped
arms.note: the shipped unregularised argmax; 0.7690 at a8eddc0. NOT required, and deliberately so: if `stack` is the entry point that gets converted to an estimator, this arm SHOULD stop scoring low, and auto-rejecting on that would be pre-committing to reject the change the battery exists to judge. Scoring high here is recorded as NO-POWER, not FAIL.

arms.name: SELECTOR-same-binary
arms.note: same binary, one parameter, n_eff == 1; 0.9768 at a8eddc0. Not required: a merge that removes --gate legitimately cannot offer it, and the loss of this control must then be reported.

arms.name: ESTIMATOR-explicit
arms.note: M62's headline invocation, 5.4777 at a8eddc0, kept for continuity. Not required: it may cease to exist.
